# Fort Worth Botanic Garden - Digital

> Home for a growing collection of digital tools and resources from the Fort Worth Botanic
> Garden (FWBG) and the Botanical Research Institute of Texas (BRIT), including datasets,
> dashboards, and applications.

This file expands on llms.txt with the full detail an LLM needs to understand what this site
is, what each part contains, and — critically — where each part actually comes from, since most
of the site is generated elsewhere and republished here.

## About FWBG and BRIT

The Fort Worth Botanic Garden (FWBG), founded in 1934, is Texas's oldest major botanic garden:
110 acres in Fort Worth's Cultural District. The Botanical Research Institute of Texas (BRIT),
founded in 1987, is a botanical research institution with a herbarium of about 1.5 million
specimens, a library, laboratories, a seed bank, and a publishing division. In 2020 the two
merged into a single nonprofit. The City of Fort Worth still owns most of the Garden's land and
buildings, and the combined organization manages the Garden. FWBG and BRIT are the same
organization, so content on this site may carry either name — FWBG generally refers to the
garden and its living collections, and BRIT refers to the research side, including the
herbarium, library, and preserved collections.

fwbg.github.io is a separate, digital-tools-and-data site published by/for the combined
organization — it is not the organization's own website. For general information (visiting,
programs, admission), see [fwbg.org](https://fwbg.org).

## Site overview

fwbg.github.io aggregates digital resources from the Fort Worth Botanic Garden and the
Botanical Research Institute of Texas (BRIT). It is fed by three distinct mechanisms (the second covers four Begonia folders):

1. **Manual direct commits** to this repo's `main` branch — used for the site's own scaffolding
   (`index.html`, `index-minimal.html` and `minimal/`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `tools/`, `.nojekyll`,
   `README.md`, `PUBLISHING.md`, `TODO.md`). Nothing generates or syncs these files automatically.
2. **Automated publish of `/begonias/` and its variants** (`/begonias-embed/`, `/begonias-unbranded/`,
   `/begonias-unbranded-plain/`) from a GitHub Actions workflow in
   [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections)
   (`.github/workflows/publish-begonia.yml`). It stages the Begonia dashboard with
   `tools/stage-pages.py` and rsyncs it (`--delete`) into this repo's `begonias/` folder using a
   PAT secret, committing as `fwbg-pages-bot <actions@github.com>`.
3. **Automated publish of `/collections/`** from a separate source repo,
   [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections), using the same bot-publish pattern.

Full detail on the publishing pipelines is in [PUBLISHING.md](https://fwbg.github.io/PUBLISHING.md).

**Implication for anyone editing this site or its sources:** `begonias/`, the three `begonias-*` variant folders, and `collections/` are
CI-generated mirrors. Edits made directly inside those folders on `fwbg.github.io` will be
silently overwritten the next time the corresponding workflow runs. The real, editable source
for the Begonia dashboard lives in `FWBG/living_collections` (dashboard files under
`dashboards/begonia/`, `fwbg/`); the source for the collections index lives in `FWBG/collections`.

## Pages

### Home — `/index.html`

Landing page for the site. States the site's purpose (digital tools and resources: datasets,
dashboards, applications) and links out to the two GitHub organizations behind the content:
[FWBG](https://github.com/FWBG) and [BRIT](https://github.com/BRITorg/), and to fwbg.org. Manually
maintained — not generated. Carries the site's Google Analytics tag.

### Home (minimal variant) — `/index-minimal.html`

Alternate homepage with the same purpose and links, styled by its own hand-written stylesheet
(`minimal/styles.css`) rather than the FWBG brand tokens. Manually maintained.

### Begonia Collection dashboard — `/begonias/`

Interactive dashboard for exploring the Begonia collection: charts (`src/charts-fwbg.jsx`), a
sortable/filterable data table (`src/table-fwbg.jsx`), and a tweaks panel for adjusting the view
(`tweaks-panel.jsx`), built as a client-rendered React app (React 18 + Babel standalone loaded
from CDN, no build step) reading data from `data/collections-v2.js`.

- **Source of truth:** [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections)
- **Published by:** `.github/workflows/publish-begonia.yml`, triggered on pushes to
  `dashboards/begonia/**`, `fwbg/**`, or `tools/stage-pages.py`, or manual dispatch.
- **Commit signature on this repo:** `Publish begonia dashboard (branded) from FWBG/living_collections@<sha>`

### Begonia dashboard variants — `/begonias-embed/`, `/begonias-unbranded/`, `/begonias-unbranded-plain/`

Three further builds of the same dashboard (same `index.html` structure, `src/`, and
`data/collections-v2.js`), published alongside the branded one from the same source repo. They differ
only in presentation:

| Folder | Difference from `/begonias/` |
| --- | --- |
| `/begonias-embed/` | Branded; sets `window.__DS_VARIANT = "embed"` and posts its page height to the parent window (allowed origins: fwbg.org and its staging alias) so it can be embedded in an iframe on fwbg.org |
| `/begonias-unbranded/` | Uses `src/tokens-unbranded.css` and `fwbg-unbranded/tokens/` instead of the FWBG brand tokens and assets |
| `/begonias-unbranded-plain/` | Unbranded, plus `window.__DS_VARIANT = "unbranded"` (plain masthead) |

- **Source of truth:** [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections), same as above.
- **Commit signatures:** `Publish begonia dashboard (embed | unbranded | unbranded, plain masthead) from FWBG/living_collections@<sha>`
- Prefer `/begonias/` as the canonical link; the variants exist for embedding and neutral-brand reuse.

### FWBG Collections — `/collections/`

Index page describing the many collections and their digital counterparts at FWBG and BRIT, with
links out to each, alongside its own `index.html` and `styles.css`. Sections as of 2026-11-11:

- **Fort Worth Botanic Garden:** Living Collections (Garden Explorer) and the Begonia Collection (`/begonias/`).
- **BRIT Philecology Herbarium:** the BRIT (collid 370), VDB (264) and NLU (309) collection profiles on
  torcherbaria.org / SERNEC, plus BRIT Mycology (MyCoPortal, collid 87) and BRIT Lichenology
  (Consortium of Lichen Herbaria portal, collid 74). The UHCC profile (collid 509) is no longer linked.
- **BRIT Library and Archives:** Sherwin J. Carlquist Collection and the FWBG Legacy and Fort Worth
  Garden Club collections on the UNT Portal to Texas History, the all-BRIT-items UNT partner page,
  [Sherwin Carlquist Digital Extended Specimen Network](https://britorg.github.io/carlquist_esn/),
  library finding aids (txarchives.org), a LibGuide, the library catalog (TCU Primo), and the
  [BRIT community on Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/communities/brit/).

- **Source of truth:** [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections) (not mirrored
  locally in this workspace; inferred from commit pattern)
- **Commit signature on this repo:** `Publish collections page from FWBG/collections@<sha>`
- This has been the most active of the two automated pipelines to date.

## External collection portals — crawling guidance

The FWBG Collections page (`/collections/`) links out to several third-party collection-management
systems. Some of these expose structured bulk-data endpoints that are far cheaper to fetch than
crawling their search/browse pages one record at a time — use these where available. Checked
2026-09-22; the Symbiota table above was re-checked 2026-11-11 (all DwC-A links returned HTTP 200).

### Symbiota herbarium portals (torcherbaria.org / SERNEC / MyCoPortal / Lichen portal)

FWBG/BRIT specimen data is hosted on Symbiota-based portals, linked from `/collections/` as
`collprofiles.php?collid=<ID>` pages. Collection IDs are per-portal, not global:

| Collection | Profile page | DwC-A download | GBIF dataset |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BRIT Herbarium | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=370` | https://portal.torcherbaria.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT-BRIT_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/defb9a47-c1a7-4fb2-9a0b-2da7c5260cad |
| Vanderbilt University Herbarium (BRIT-VDB) | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=264` | https://sernecportal.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT-VDB_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/3111dc38-3143-4792-9802-610f1de4961c |
| Univ. of Louisiana at Monroe Herbarium, R. Dale Thomas Collection (BRIT-NLU) | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=309` | https://sernecportal.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT-NLU_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/bb0366a9-2a7e-44f8-9c9a-e49c23dae2f8 |
| BRIT Mycology (MyCoPortal) | `mycoportal.org/portal/collections/misc/collprofiles.php?collid=87` | https://mycoportal.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT_DwC-A.zip | (not listed on profile page) |
| BRIT Lichens (Lichen portal) | `lichenportal.org/portal/collections/misc/collprofiles.php?collid=74` | https://lichenportal.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/668d3577-f727-4526-aebe-9f6c7ef449ae |

Each collection profile page links directly to a **Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A)** zip — a complete,
structured snapshot of every specimen record — plus a GBIF dataset page. EML metadata for any
collection on this network is also available at the stable, collid-parametrized path
`datasets/emlhandler.php?collid=<ID>` relative to the portal root.

**General rule:** for any link matching `*/collections/misc/collprofiles.php?collid=*` (a Symbiota
collection profile, on this or any other SEINet/SERNEC-network portal), fetch the DwC-A/GBIF/EML
links on that profile page instead of crawling the occurrence-search interface — this pattern holds
for any future Symbiota-hosted collection linked from this site, not just the three above.

### Zenodo (BRIT community)

[zenodo.org/communities/brit](https://zenodo.org/communities/brit/) is linked from `/collections/`. Zenodo
provides a public REST API; prefer it over crawling the community pages (not verified here).

### UNT Portal to Texas History (texashistory.unt.edu)

Collections linked from `/collections/` (e.g. `/explore/collections/SJCC/`; partner pages such as
`/explore/partners/BRIT/` and `/explore/partners/FWGC/` are also linked) expose a JSON API per
collection at `/explore/collections/<CODE>/api/` and an RSS feed at `/explore/collections/<CODE>/feed/`.
Prefer the API for structured metadata over paging through browse/search results.

### FWBG Garden Explorer (fwbg.gardenexplorer.org)

Live-plant-records system (IrisBG, by Compositae AS). No public bulk export or API was found on the
public interface as of 2026-09-22 — treat as browse-only and avoid exhaustive crawling; a targeted
name/genus search is the practical option here.

### TCU Primo catalog, txarchives.org (TARO), CBHL LibGuides

Not verified for bulk-access endpoints — the txarchives.org fetch was blocked by an access-control
check during this check, and the others weren't checked. Treat as ordinary browse targets unless
confirmed otherwise; don't assume an API exists.

## Source repositories

| Repo | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [FWBG/FWBG.github.io](https://github.com/FWBG/FWBG.github.io) | This site — the publish target for all three mechanisms above |
| [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections) | Editable source of the Begonia dashboard, published into `/begonias/` and the three `/begonias-*/` variant folders |
| [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections) | Editable source of the collections index, published into `/collections/` |
| [FWBG on GitHub](https://github.com/FWBG) | Full list of Fort Worth Botanic Garden repositories |
| [BRIT on GitHub](https://github.com/BRITorg/) | Full list of Botanical Research Institute of Texas repositories |

## Notes for LLM agents

- If asked to change something visible on fwbg.github.io, first check whether the path is under
  `/begonias/`, `/begonias-embed/`, `/begonias-unbranded/`, `/begonias-unbranded-plain/`, or `/collections/` — if so, the change belongs in the source repo
  (`living_collections` or `collections`), not here.
- `index.html` and `index-minimal.html` (with `minimal/`), plus the docs, `llms*.txt`, and `tools/`, are the
  parts of this repo safe to edit directly.
- This site aggregates content across repositories; it does not itself contain the underlying
  botanical/collections datasets — those live in the source repos linked above.
